conviction_note: The Q3 numbers are new (no profit warning since 14 July) and the FY guide is in play, because the company tied it to fuel prices not rising 'significantly', and diesel then went from 2.1 to 2.4 EUR/l (Statistics Finland). That sets a large unsigned move of about 6%. The direction is balanced: the guide-cut risk has been public since mid-September and the stock is down about 13% since then. Weighing against the cut, there has been no separate profit warning four weeks after quarter-end, where in July one came two weeks after. So p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0. The findings sum to -0.3; both measurements say there is no directional edge.

findings.finding: The revised 2026 guide (adj. EBITA 33-38m) was explicitly conditioned on fuel prices not rising significantly from the July level. Statistics Finland's average diesel price then rose from 2.1 EUR/l (July) to 2.3 (August) and 2.4 (September, +49% y/y), and the coverage analyst puts FY at about 33.9, so guidance-cut or low-end risk sits on the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The July 2026 guide cut, a separate inside-information release, moved -3.9% on the day (14 July, close 6.71 vs 6.98). The Q1 print with a large miss moved -4.8% and then -2.7% the next day (6-7 May 2026). The H1 print with no new guide information moved +3.7% (6 Aug).
findings.original_quote: Statistics Finland (fi): 'Dieselin verollinen keskihinta oli 2,4 euroa ja bensiini 95:n 2,3 euroa litralta.' ('The average diesel price including tax was 2.4 euros per litre.'), September 2026, https://stat.fi/fi/julkaisu/cmfb00k1e2u3007usmee2c0f0. Inderes (fi), 2026-10-26: 'dieselin hinnan nousun myötä koko vuoden tulos on arviomme mukaan painumassa ohjeistushaarukan keskikohdan alapuolelle noin 34 MEUR:oon. Siten ohjeistuksen laskun riski on selvästi kohonnut.' ('with the diesel price rise, the full-year result in our estimate is sinking below the midpoint of the range to about EUR 34m. The risk of a guidance cut has therefore clearly risen.'). Company (en): 'The outlook is based on the assumption that a prolonged war in Iran will not significantly increase fuel prices from their current level.'
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock fell about 13% (7.05 to 6.1) after Helsingin Sanomat's 16 September 'diesel at a record' story, which forum users linked to the guide's fuel condition, and after Inderes trimmed its estimate on 30 September. What remains is the event itself. Consensus sits at the low end, so a formal cut (instead of low-end language) is not fully in a price that still trades at P/E about 10 with a 6.9% yield. If a cut were fully priced, the stock would be trading at a discount to the Inderes FY 33.9 path, and the preview would not still expect the guide to be repeated.
findings.independence: Two independent sources for the inputs: Statistics Finland's CPI series (https://stat.fi/fi/julkaisu/cmfb00k1e2u3007usmee2c0f0) for the diesel price, and the Inderes Q3 preview for the earnings transmission (https://www.inderes.fi/analyst-comments/lassila-and-tikanoja-q326-ennakko-kustannuspaineet-jatkuvat). The analyst's own forum estimate puts the extra cost at about EUR 2m before pass-through and EUR 1-1.5m net (https://forum.inderes.com/t/lassila-tikanoja/1634).

findings.finding: No inside-information release or profit warning has appeared on the Nasdaq Nordic feed since 14 July, four weeks after Q3 closed. In July the company published a separate warning two weeks after quarter-end, which suggests management does not see FY adj. EBITA below 33m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last time the guide was reiterated with no new guide information (H1, 6 Aug 2026), the stock rose 3.7%.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-27 (feed read 14:40 UTC; last Lassila & Tikanoja items are the 2026-10-14 managers' transaction and the 2026-10-05 results-date notice)
findings.why_not_priced: This is an inference from an absence, so it carries little weight. The market can see the same absence, but the Q3 preview still frames the release around the risk of a cut, and the stock kept drifting lower into October (6.53 to 6.03). That drift suggests the absence has not been read as reassurance. MAR does not force a warning before a scheduled release only one day away, so the absence is weaker evidence than it would be mid-quarter.

findings.finding: Company-stated tailwinds for Q3 sales: industrial maintenance shutdowns are weighted to H2 2026 against the prior year, and remediation had a strong project pipeline (Hazardous Waste and Remediation sales +33.2% in H1 2026). Inderes models Q3 sales down about 3% to 113m while the Bloomberg consensus models 118m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to a sales-line surprise alone; the prints moved on EBITA and the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and inside what the company told the market, so it is close to 0. It is filed because the two estimate sources differ by about 4% on sales, which leaves the sales line genuinely uncertain. Waste Management, the margin line, is under municipalisation pressure, so this does not offset the fuel effect.

baseline_tension: The negative guidance risk agrees with the run-up (-6% over 20d, -9% over 60d, -13% since mid-September), so most of it looks priced. The absence of a warning and the cheap valuation cut the other way, so the evidence does not beat the free control in either direction.
language_note: Finnish sources carried the Inderes Q3 preview (26 Oct) with the Q3 bar table and the Bloomberg 3-analyst consensus; the English search returned no preview at all.

The Finnish Inderes forum carried the coverage analyst's own quantification (about EUR 2m extra fuel cost vs the July level, EUR 1-1.5m net of pass-through) and its link to the guide's fuel condition, plus the HS 16 Sep 'diesel at a record' story; no English source made that link.
Statistics Finland's Finnish CPI release gave the September diesel price (2.4 EUR/l, +49.1% y/y).
The company's own releases are bilingual and added nothing in Finnish that the English versions lacked.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' and 'numbers not pre-released move ~7%': abs_move_pct raised from 5.0 to 6.0 (held below 7 for a low-vol, 19% annualised name; the reaction history is not used as a cap).
Guidance finding sized on the guidance scale: the fuel-condition breach moved from -1.0 to -1.5 (about 35% cut probability times a -6% guide-cut reaction, partly priced by the -13% drift).
The no-warning finding is also a guidance-line finding: +0.8 to +1.0.
'Inside what the company already told the market': the H2-weighted shutdowns finding cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
'Positioning is the thing to beat': the truncated-zero register gives no anchor, so p_up stays 50.
